title: CANINE: Pre-training an Efficient Tokenization-Free Encoder for Language Representation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on typologically diverse downstream tasks (TyDi QA and MasakhaNER) to measure disparities across languages and scripts, specifically demonstrating how standard subword tokenizers disadvantage morphologically rich languages, languages without spaces, and completely fail on unseen scripts (e.g., Amharic).
